label: NOT_EVIDENCE_POWER_ANALYSIS
provenance_caveat: Quantitative power/sample-size closure derived from real retained Hyperliquid partial artifacts (non-synthetic) on 2026-04-20T03:00Z..2026-09-28T23:00Z (24 symbols x 3885 bars, ~161.875 days). NOT the 283-day spec window and NOT performance evidence. Projections are base-rate extrapolations with stated assumptions; n=2 observed exploratory trades provide no stable variance estimate and are a caveat, not a result.

observed_base_rates.variance_caveat: Sample standard deviation computed from n=2 episodes is numerically unstable and dominated by the BTC liquidation; treat as an order-of-magnitude diagnostic only, not a reliable estimator.

assumptions: Crash-day arrival is approximately Poisson with rate lambda_day = 0.02471 crash-days/day estimated from 4 crash days over 161.875 days (24 symbols).
Traded-episode conversion given a crash day is ~0.5 (2 traded episodes / 4 crash days) on the exploratory spec-literal path with portfolio constraints; this is highly uncertain at n=4.

Symbol-count scaling assumes additional symbols contribute crash episodes at a similar per-symbol-day rate and are not perfectly correlated; correlation across symbols on shared market crashes likely reduces effective independence, so symbol scaling is an optimistic upper bound unless episodes are de-duplicated by day.

Episode PnL distribution is unknown/unstable (n=2, one liquidation). No claim is made that the true mean is positive; CI-width projections below are framed as detectability of a hypothesized effect size, not as evidence of edge.

calendar_time_projection_same_universe_2.note: At observed rates, the 283-day spec window (~3.5 expected traded episodes for 24 symbols) is insufficient for >=10 episodes in expectation; ~810 days at the same symbol set/rate are needed for E[N]=10.

symbol_scaling_projection_hold_283_days.feasibility_note: Requires ~195 symbols contributing independent traded episodes at observed per-symbol rates over 283 days. Hyperliquid universe passing $5M gate was 31-32 in recent probes and crash clustering across symbols on the same days (4 shared crash days total) breaks independence; this scaling is not feasible as an independence assumption and is presented as a bound, not a plan.

episode_block_bootstrap_ci_width_project.caveat: CI width scales ~1/sqrt(n) for a stable variance; with n=2 the observed sample SD is dominated by one liquidation and is not a reliable sigma estimate. Values below use sigma_hat=2679.56 USD/episode (diagnostic only) to illustrate scaling, not to forecast a real CI.
episode_block_bootstrap_ci_width_project.interpretation: Even under a (very uncertain) sigma_hat, a 95% episode-block CI excluding 0 at n=10 would require |mean_episode_pnl| > ~1661 USD with that variance profile. Observed mean is -1335 USD at n=2 (sign negative, unstable). No detectability claim is supported; the projection shows the >=10-episode target is a necessary but not sufficient condition given observed volatility/instability.

reconciliation_with_memo_target.memo_requires: >=10 independent crash episodes with episode-block bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0 + crash-day permutation p<0.05 + full-portfolio placebo p<0.05
reconciliation_with_memo_target.current_state: 2 traded episodes, 4 crash days, 2 trades, total PnL -2670.76 (exploratory, NOT evidence). All inference criteria NOT_APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN due to underpower.
reconciliation_with_memo_target.gap: 8 additional traded episodes needed to reach the count floor alone; at observed rates the 283-day window and the currently liquid symbol set cannot plausibly deliver this without either much longer history or a materially different regime (neither of which can be assumed).
reconciliation_with_memo_target.verdict: UNDERPOWERED — the retained partial chain cannot close the memo's GO criteria; only a verified full 283-day Hyperliquid-native archive plus sufficient realized episodes can.
